strengths.value: First method to identify and target massive outliers at the FFN down-projection input, where prior methods like SmoothQuant and OmniQuant fail.

ev.quote: we first discover that these extremely large activations exist at the input of the down-projection layer within the FFN module

strengths.value: Sets new SOTA on W4A4 PTQ across LLaMA1/2/3, Vicuna, Mistral, Phi2, with up to 10% MMLU gain over Atom on Vicuna-13B.

ev.quote: DuQuant_{+LWC} surpasses Atom by 10.01% under zero-shot settings and 6.95% under five-shot settings

strengths.value: Extremely fast quantization runtime of 50s for LLaMA2-7B and 270s for LLaMA2-70B; no GPTQ or gradient training required.

ev.quote: we successfully quantize LLaMA2-13B in just 71s with superior performance

strengths.value: Open-source code with custom W4A4 kernels delivering 2.08x pre-filling speedup and 3.20x memory savings on RTX 3090.

ev.quote: Our code is available at https://github.com/Hsu1023/DuQuant

weaknesses.value: No specialized strategy for calibration data selection; uses generic random WikiText2 sampling like prior work.

ev.quote: The primary limitation of our method is the lack of a specialized strategy for calibration data selection

weaknesses.value: Phi2-2.8B shows quantization instability and overflow in QV multiplications; W4A4 PPL still degrades from 9.71 to 20.65.

ev.section: Comparison with FP16 models on MT-Bench.
ev.quote: Regarding the Phi2-2.8B model, it often experiences instability in matrix multiplication between queries and values, leading to overflow issues

weaknesses.value: Permutation rotates incur extra 8.9-9.3% compute on top of W4A4 baseline cost, limiting maximum theoretical speedup.

ev.quote: incurring an additional 8.9% computational cost on LLaMA2-7B and 9.3% on LLaMA2-13B compared to the W4A4 setup

weaknesses.value: Requires Hadamard rotation hard-wired for QK and OV multiplications, adding implementation complexity for online matmuls.

ev.quote: for multiplications between activations in MSA, such as Query and Key, attention outputs and Value, we apply a Hadamard rotation matrix

limitations.value: Tested only on data-centre GPUs (RTX 3090, A100); no edge or mobile deployment is evaluated.

ev.quote: all experiments are done on NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs for small-scale models and NVIDIA A100 GPUs for large-scale models

limitations.value: Safety, jailbreak, refusal, bias, and toxicity behaviour after quantization are not measured anywhere in the paper.

ev.quote: Our work identifies the presence of massive outliers in down-projection layer of FFN modules, which significantly complicates low-bit weight-activation quantization

limitations.value: Sub-4-bit regimes (W3A3, W2A2, ternary) are not explored; the method targets W4A4 and W6A6.

ev.quote: our primary evaluation in this paper focuses on 4-bit and 6-bit quantization for weights and activations

limitations.value: Energy and power consumption (Watts/joules) are not measured; only latency, memory, and runtime are reported.
